class.name: CompiledScenery
class.brief_description: What a scenery is made of.
class.description: Read whole and registered with the servers ([code]SceneryServer[/code]): its tracks, traction, models, sounds, lines, trainsets, stations, scripts and nodes. A plugin's subclass carries what only its format has.

members.member: The lines, drawn by SceneryLines (not nodes, so not in [member nodes]).
The scenario's scripts, relative to the scenery directory.
The signal boxes, for a list of them (not drawn).
The stations, for a list of them (not drawn).

The [TrackRenderingServer] backend the scenery's tracks of no backend of their own prefer: it draws them unless another one has a higher priority ([method TrackRenderingServer.track_set_preferred_backend]); empty for none.
The trainsets and their vehicles, built through the servers (not nodes, so not in [member nodes]).
